Legs.Citation: ENVELOPE: agreement is required within Aem·2^-15 plus float-kernel slack (widened for velocity by a factor of the natural frequency, since the velocity channel carries an extra omega-squared scale), per SecondOrderDynamics.Evaluate's own documented remarks — Evaluate is stated there to be an approximation of the exact propagator, not bit-identical to it. THIS law folds frequency to [0.5, 8] Hz rather than the full (0, 100] Hz authoring band (the upper bound avoids many-cycle phase-rounding divergence over one second at 240 one-tick steps; the lower bound avoids a near-zero decay rate where both sides' rounding noise dominates a genuinely tiny signal) and nudges the damping ratio off the near-critical band |zeta-1| < 1/6 (there the overdamped closed form divides two nearly-equal decay rates by a near-zero sigma, a genuinely different numerical regime this generic bound is not shaped to cover)
